## Spruce Biosciences Announces Presentation of MPS IIIB Natural History Data at the 55th Child Neurology Society Annual Meeting


October 8, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.sprucebio.com/node/9311/pdf)


SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 8, 2026--[Spruce Biosciences, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fsprucebio.com%2F&esheet=54618670&newsitemid=20261008501925&lan=en-US&anchor=Spruce+Biosciences%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=417719769fd94627f4fc632c9392d422) (Nasdaq: SPRB), a late-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing novel therapies for neurological disorders with significant unmet medical need, today announced that data from Study 250-902 (NCT03227042), a prospective, multicenter, multinational, noninterventional, longitudinal natural history study designed to characterize disease progression in pediatric participants with severe, non-attenuated Sanfilippo Syndrome Type B (MPS IIIB) will be presented at the[55th Child Neurology Society (CNS) Annual Meeting](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.childneurologysociety.org%2Fcolleagues%2Fnetwork%2Fcns-annual-meeting%2F&esheet=54618670&newsitemid=20261008501925&lan=en-US&anchor=55th+Child+Neurology+Society+%28CNS%29+Annual+Meeting&index=2&md5=64b9f154f4b996091b711e260f68ebff) , taking place October 14–17, 2026, in Montréal, Québec, Canada. The poster will be available on the Spruce Biosciences[website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.sprucebio.com%2Fnews-and-events%2Fpresentations&esheet=54618670&newsitemid=20261008501925&lan=en-US&anchor=website&index=3&md5=adb8f97223fbf87a5cac76bf6f265a74) following the presentation.


**CNS Annual Meeting Poster Presentation Details**


**Title:** In-depth analyses of cognition, motor, communication, and adaptive natural history disease course in participants with MPS IIIB
**Session Type:** Poster Presentation – Neurodevelopmental Disorders
**Poster Number:** 235
**Presentation Date & Time:** October 15, 2026, 12:30 p.m. – 1:45 p.m. EDT and 5:30 p.m. – 7:30 p.m. EDT
**Presenter:** Ilyas Okur, M.D., Professor of Pediatrics and Pediatric Metabolism Specialist, Gazi University Faculty of Medicine, Ankara, Türkiye
**Authors:** Ilyas Okur, M.D.; Fatih Ezgu, M.D.; Yin-Hsiu Chien, M.D., Ph.D.; Cara O’Neill, M.D., FAAP; Roberto Giugliani, M.D., Ph.D.; Can Ficicioglu, M.D., Ph.D.; Igor Nestrasil, M.D., Ph.D.; Irene J. Chang, M.D.; Elizabeth R. Jalazo, M.D.; Martha Solano, M.D.; Saba Sile, M.D.; Richard Kim, M.D.; Kirk Ways, M.D., Ph.D.; and Nicole Muschol, M.D.


**About Spruce Biosciences**


Spruce Biosciences is a late-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing novel therapies for neurological disorders with significant unmet medical need. Spruce’s lead product candidate, tralesinidase alfa enzyme replacement therapy (TA-ERT), is in late-stage development for the treatment of MPS IIIB, a devastating pediatric neurodegenerative disorder for which there are no FDA-approved therapies. TA-ERT has received Breakthrough Therapy Designation, Rare Pediatric Disease Designation, Fast Track Designation and Orphan Drug Designation from the FDA, as well as Orphan Drug Designation in the European Union.
